title: Steeped Dutch Cheese Wrap
description: A unique Japanese-inspired dish featuring a crispy Dutch cheese wrapped around a savory, beer-steeped filling.
instructions: Steep the Japanese-Style Beer in a saucepan at 60°C/140°F for 10 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and sesame seeds together in a separate bowl.
Add the steeped beer mixture to the bowl and stir well.
Place the Dutch Cheese in a separate pan and heat over low heat until melted.
Add the beer mixture to the melted cheese and mix well.
Place the Wrapping Bread on a flat surface and spread the cheese-beer mixture evenly.
Place sliced Green Onions on top of the cheese-beer mixture.
Roll the wrapping bread into a neat cylinder.
